Karnataka

CBSE-affiliated schools across every Karnataka district from the official SARAS register, together with the state's ICSE schools and the BMTC bus-pass lists.

    Karnataka at a glance

    The BMTC school lists

    Bengaluru Metropolitan Transport Corporation publishes CBSE and ICSE school lists for student bus passes. The site refuses automated downloads, so these open for you to check by hand.

    Government of Karnataka

    Where this comes from

    The CBSE records are a full capture of the SARAS 7.0 affiliated-schools directory: affiliation number, school code, district, level, head of school, address and the website each school filed with the board. ICSE entries add phone numbers and email addresses. State-board coverage is thinner and best pursued through UDISE+.

    CBSE SARAS affiliated-schools directory

    The source of the 33,151 CBSE records here. Each school's detail page carries extra fields — PIN, year of foundation, school type, affiliation period and managing trust — and every school in this directory links straight to its own page there.

    Central Board of Secondary Education
    CISCE School Locator

    The official ICSE and ISC register. The 245 ICSE entries in this directory come from a published state-wise compilation that carries phone and email, which the official locator does not expose in bulk — check any entry here against the locator before relying on it.

    Council for the Indian School Certificate Examinations
    Know Your School (UDISE+)

    Government, aided and private schools under every state board. Search by name, 11-digit UDISE code or PIN, no login. The only realistic route to state-board coverage at scale.

    Ministry of Education

    CBSE records captured from the CBSE SARAS affiliated-schools directory; ICSE records from a published state-wise compilation. Heads of school, phone numbers and websites are as filed and go out of date — each school links to its own official board record and a live search so you can confirm before relying on a detail. Announcements can't be read from another site by a page like this, so each school links out to its own site and a news search instead.
